Context window is ~7K for the homelab variant — roughly what it was at Q5_K_M GGUF before v3a shrunk it to save memory and keep the bot under $0.40/minute at the bulk-LLama2 price tier. That's deliberately smaller than the 24K window of the base model, because the homelab variant is meant for faster response on cheaper hardware (Ry590/RAM8GB) without the need to hold long context. The tradeoff is that recent context carries more weight — a full turn-then-context window is 13% of total tokens, not 4%.
